reasons: Preferred level incomplete: the cost-allocation element (Vendor bears audit cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%) is entirely absent from the operative text; the margin comment's cross-reference to Section 22.2 is non-operative and cannot supply it.
Fallback also fails on the same material term (Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%), so the clause does not sit at an acceptable level.

Minimality fails: the edit rewrites the whole clause (20 words to 76, changed-character ratio 0.831) and adds unbargained-for extras beyond the playbook elements — "without unreasonable disruption", off-site-where-practicable, and a records-scope limitation.

Fix: keep a tighter rewrite covering only frequency, 30 days' written notice, business hours, independent confidentiality-bound auditor, no systems access, and add the missing sentence: "The audit shall be at Vendor's cost, unless it reveals underpayment exceeding 5% of amounts due, in which case Customer shall bear the reasonable cost of the audit."
No contradiction or dangling mechanic is introduced; surrounding terms remain effective.
